messages.subject: RE: Project Redwood — draft sale contract (our mark-up v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Our mark-up attached (v2 redline). Two substantive points:

1. Clause 9.2 — we've extended the arrears assignment window from three to six months; three is too tight for our client to chase tenant arrears.

2. Clause 13 — we've added a £150,000 review retention held by us as stakeholder pending the Mercer Wells review, released to the seller once the reviewed rent is agreed, net of any sum due to the buyer. Given the size of the potential uplift we think a retention is justified.

Otherwise we can largely live with the draft. Grateful for a quick turn.

James

messages.subject: RE: Project Redwood — draft sale contract (seller response v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Seller has considered your v2. Responses (v3 redline to follow from Nadia):

- Clause 9.2 — six months agreed.
- Clause 13 retention — agreed in principle but Hartmoor will only accept £100,000, not £150,000, and want a longstop: if the review isn't agreed or determined by 30 September 2026 the retention is released to them in full, with your client's accounting rights under 13.2 continuing. We think that's a fair compromise.

If that works we're essentially there and can aim to exchange w/c 21 April.

Alistair
